summary: Build interview, validation, and roadmap skills in 5 days. Learn practical tools to reduce product risk and prove customer demand.
lede: Customer validation and product discovery help product, research, analysis, design, and innovation professionals turn customer evidence into product decisions. The course covers framing customer problems, designing interviews, mapping assumptions, testing concepts and value propositions, and synthesizing findings into recommendations and roadmap inputs through structured exercises and practical tools such as insight matrices and validation trackers.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to turn customer evidence into product decisions, validation plans, and roadmap inputs. Product Managers who prioritize opportunities using discovery evidence. Product Owners who refine backlog items from validated needs. UX Researchers who structure interviews and synthesize customer insights. Business Analysts who translate user problems into testable assumptions. Innovation Managers who assess concept viability before investment. Customer Insights Analysts who organize interview and survey findings. Service Designers who validate journeys and value propositions. Digital Product Leads who align discovery with release decisions. Startup Founders who test problem-solution fit before scaling. Strategy Managers who need evidence for product and market decisions.
prerequisites: Recommended prerequisites: working knowledge of product development, customer-facing business needs, or basic market research concepts; no programming required. You should be comfortable reading product briefs, discussing user needs, and working with simple digital tools such as spreadsheets or collaborative whiteboards. If your role already touches interviews, roadmap input, usability findings, or concept testing, you will be able to apply the course methods quickly.
